title: An Optimal Control Approach To Transformer Training
abstract: arXiv:2603.09571v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this paper, we develop a rigorous optimal control-theoretic approach to Transformer training that respects key structural constraints such as (i) realized-input-independence during execution, (ii) the ensemble control nature of the problem, and (iii) positional dependence. We model the Transformer architecture as a discrete-time controlled particle system with shared actions, exhibiting noise-free controlled McKean--Vlasov dynamics, and we show that lifting the dynamics to probability measures produces a fully-observed Markov decision process (MDP). Positional encodings are incorporated into the state space to preserve the sequence order under lifting. Using the dynamic programming principle, we establish the existence of globally optimal policies under mild assumptions of compactness. translated_title: 一种用于Transformer训练的最优控制方法
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种严格的最优控制理论方法用于Transformer训练，该方法遵循关键的结构性约束，包括：执行过程中与实际输入的独立性、问题的集合控制特性，以及位置依赖性。我们将Transformer架构建模为具有共享动作的离散时间受控粒子系统，呈现出无噪声的受控McKean--Vlasov动力学，并证明将该动力学提升到概率测度空间可产生一个完全可观测的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。位置编码被纳入状态空间中，以便在提升过程中保持序列顺序。利用动态规划原理，我们在紧致性的温和假设下建立了全局最优策略的存在性。我们进一步证明，提升问题中的闭环策略等价于依赖于初始分布的开环策略，这些策略……
tldr: 本文将Transformer训练建模为受控McKean-Vlasov动力学的最优控制问题，通过将动力学提升到概率测度空间构造完全可观测的MDP，并证明了全局最优策略的存在性及其与依赖初始分布的开环策略的等价性。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates Transformer training as an optimal control problem governed by controlled McKean-Vlasov dynamics, shows that lifting to probability measures yields a fully-observed MDP, and establishes the existence of globally optimal policies equivalent to initial-distribution-dependent open-loop policies.
